review_scope: Independent AI-assisted technical review of the new actual-transcript study; no human speech validation or peer-review claim
source_restrictions: Local source bytes and saved artifacts only; independent statistical recalculation/refits allowed; no new network requests, browser access or LLM/ASR inference without root coordination
authored_output_boundary: research/transcript-review/ only; collection-runner and source-owner files remain held

rounds.focus: sampling unit, corpus boundaries, model/threshold choices, instability and alternative explanations
Rendered paper/dashboard and export bindings against reviewed source hashes

critical_limits: 20 ASR recordings contain nineteen Bashar-related publisher episodes and one separate Ashtar creator episode
16 authored publications are a separate corpus with different source format and author distribution
Source recording/publication is the sampling unit; segments, output formats, publishers and entity mentions are not automatically independent samples
ASR output is unverified and host/guest/advertising/claimed-entity speech remains unsegmented
Lexical similarity, topics and co-mentions do not measure agreement or ET origin
